messages:
maria: Following the DR postmortem, starting this thread to track actionable items for the next failover game-day. We want owners, brief mitigation steps, and dates. Keep entries short so we can close fast.

nate: I'll take network routing tests and DNS/BGP checks. Plan: run a staged failover to eu-west then back, measure DNS convergence and LB health.

olga: I'll update the restore runbook and add a recovery checklist with clear RTO/RPO estimates. Will include exact s3 keys and a dry-run restore command.

priyanka: I'll cover model-serving fallbacks and a compatibility matrix for quantized vs fp16 variants. Also adding a test in model CI to validate runtime ops.

sre-bot: auto: created epic "DR-game-day-177888" in backlog. Links: https://boards.redwood/epic/177888

maria: Minimum checklist items to capture in runbook:
- pre-game: lower DNS TTL to 30s, notify CDN owners, snapshot KV cache metrics
- execute: traffic shift in 4x 25% steps, run healthcheck after each step, monitor p95 latency and cache miss rate
- restore path: full backup restore + WAL apply; verify logical consistency; attach restore time metrics to ticket
- post-game: revert TTL, run cache warmup, postmortem note with recurrence tags

nate: Draft routing check commands (from admin host):
```bash
# check LB TTL and LB endpoints
dig +short lb.api.redwood | xargs -n1 -I {} dig +noall +answer {}
# simulate shift via control API
curl -X POST https://control.redwood/internal/shift -d '{"from":"us-east-1","to":"eu-west-1","percent":25}'
```

olga: Restore dry-run snippet I'll add to docs: 
```text
1) spin test-cluster with same major version
2) fetch full backup: aws s3 cp s3://prod-backups/full/2026-03-15.tar.gz /tmp
3) extract and load
4) apply WAL: aws s3 sync s3://prod-backups/wal/ /tmp/wal/
5) run `restore-verify --mode=smoke`
6) record restore-duration metric
```
I'll also add expected timings per TB.

priyanka: For model fallbacks: mapping file example `serve-fallbacks.yaml` with keys -> fallback_model_id. CI test will run sample prompts across both variants and assert outputs are within tolerance.

maria: Recurring incident patterns we want to watch and tag: CACHE_MISS_SPIKE, RESTORE_TIMEOUT, MODEL_INFERENCE_ERRORS. Add these as labels in the postmortem board.

nate: Note about CDN and DNS: during last run we had 90s DNS TTL causing 2nd-step delay. I'll coordinate a TTL window with CDN and set temporary low TTL during the 30-min game-day window.

olga: Ownership & deadlines:
- nate: run routing rehearsal + provide CI job by 1778960000 (9 days)
- olga: runbook + dry-run results by 1778890000 (1 day)
- priyanka: model compatibility CI + fallback mapping by 1778975000 (11 days)

sre-bot: auto: created CI job `dr/rehearsal-routing` scheduled weekly; failure -> opens incident stub.

maria: Add mitigation notes to runbook: on cache-miss storms, keep read-only replica traffic and run KV pre-warm up to 30 minutes prior, do not flip 100% at once. For model mismatches, automatic fallback must be opt-in via a safe flag.

priyanka: Quick question: for KV pre-warm do we replay hot key list or stream reads from replica? I prefer streaming controlled-rate reads to avoid thundering herd.

nate: Agreed on streaming. Also adding a small script prototype to gradually ramp: `kv-ramp --source=replica --qps=200 --duration=900`. I'll push to infra repo.

olga: I'll include a TTL-check command in the pre-game checklist: `dig +noall +answer api.redwood | awk '{print $2 " " $5}'` to show TTL + IP.

maria: Good. Emily (not present) will schedule the game-day invites but please assume 03:00 UTC next Tue low-traffic slot. We'll confirm in calendar.

sre-bot: auto: reminder set for 48h before 1778960000 to owners.

maria: Post updates here with links to PRs/CI jobs. I'll mark items done in the epic once I see PRs. Closing note: keep messages short in this thread so the tracker stays scannable.

nate: PR for routing rehearsal: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/pull/543 (draft).

olga: Runbook PR: https://git.redwood/repo/docs/pull/421 (WIP).

priyanka: Fallback mapping added to infra repo: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/commit/def456. CI job created: https://ci.redwood/jobs/2456.

maria: Last check-in timestamp here: 1778881450. I'll ping again in 48h if any items are not PR'd. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
